question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Nvidia)

calls.reasoning: Nvidia guided Q3 FY27 revenue to $108B +/-2% (no China DC compute). Over the last 8 quarters actual/guide-midpoint ranged 1.025-1.08 (mean ~1.05): Q2 FY27 96.2 vs 91, Q1 81.6 vs 78, Q4 FY26 68.1 vs 65, Q3 FY26 57.0 vs 54. Applying that to 108 gives ~110.7-116.6, centered ~113.4; consistent with whisper/preview estimates of $113-114B. Downside risks: Rubin ramp timing, supply constraints; upside: Rubin contribution exceeding 20% of DC, China H20-style sales. No human prediction market found on Kalshi/Polymarket/Manifold. ~10% mass above $116B (needs >7.4% beat, seen once in 8 quarters but more often in FY24); below $105B negligible.

- Earnings date reported as ~Nov 17-18 2026 (question text says no earlier than Nov 25); resolves off revenue in first quarterly release after Sep 30 2026 (8-K), initial figure only.
- Status quo: Nvidia reports above top of guidance range.
- Event window: quarter Jul 27 -> ~Oct 25 2026 already complete; report pending as of Nov 3 2026.
